scoring_boundary: prediction_correct fields in raw use records compare a fixed decoder class with the independent generator's nominal event type. They do not alone establish future counterfactual harm or utility under changed environmental history.
closure: Two separately frozen physical phases measured and retained; the second was exploratory after the reconstructed original-phase mechanism.
